title: High-Post Flash Feed
description: A post player flashes from the weak-side block to the high post against a zone; the wing feeds the flash, and the high post turns to read the low post or the shooter.

content.objective: Get the ball into the high post against a zone and make the next decision quickly: high-low pass, kick-out or shot.
content.setup: Wing with the ball, post players on both blocks, a shooter in the opposite corner; optional zone defenders.
instructions: The weak-side post flashes to the free-throw line when the ball is on the wing.
The wing passes to the flash with a bounce or chest pass.
The high post catches, pivots to face the rim and reads.
Options: high-low pass to the other post sealing, kick to the corner shooter, or shoot.
coachingPoints: Flash hard and show two hands.
Catch and face: the high post sees everything.
Low post seals the defender as soon as the flash catches.
commonMistakes: Flashing too slowly, so the zone closes.
High post catching with the back to the basket and not turning.
Forcing the high-low pass into a defender.
content.safety: Zone defenders play legally; posts do not push off when sealing.
progressions: Add a 2-3 zone of five defenders.
Shot clock of six seconds from the flash.
regressions: Pass to the high post from the top.
variations: Short-corner option for the low post.
High post drives if the middle defender steps up.
successCriteria: Correct decision after the catch on most reps.
Catch made in the gap of the zone.
content.gameApplication: The high post is the weak spot of most zones; a good feed and a quick decision break them down.
